items.hyp: Okufaananako ebyo ebikola ku kufuna firimu, ebintu ebyo ebyaliwo kubanga ebyo ebyaliwo ebyali bya Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Oluvannyuma lw'okukola emyaka mingi mu Mozambique, e Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekyo kiba kikola kye kikola, ekitongole kya CinemArena kijja kuba kya Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya CinemArena mu Uganda kikulu nnyo mu kuzzaawo enkulaakulana ya maanyi, olw'okuba kye kikola n'omulimu gw'omutindo ogw'ensi yonna okuva mu kwe kuba n'ekola kya Amakula Film.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: N'olwekyo abantu abalala bali mu Gulu, abo abaali bakyusa enkola ya kufuna emirimu gyabwe okutuusa ku buli bw'enguzi.

items.hyp: Enkambi y'omu maka g'amaanyi enteekateeka okukwata ku bitundu bya Uganda.
items.ref: Emmotoka y'abasuubuzi etambula yeetooloola ekibuga n'ebitundu by'ekyalo mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Abakazi ba Acholi ab'omu nteekateeka bwe bawulira abantu okumala emizango gy'ebbeeyi bwe bali ku lujjukujju, bwe bali bibe nnyo mu bulamu.
items.ref: Abazinyi abazina amazina Amacholi basanyusa abantu ku nnaku ez'okukola bongera okunyumisa ekintu.

items.hyp: Abaawandiisi b'ekitongole ekyo bagamba nti enkola ennungi eyo eno ye ennungi ya Barak Obama ey'okukubaganya okwagala mu ofiisi.
items.ref: Abategesi ba pulojekiti bagamba nti omukutu gwabwe ogw'empuliziganya gwekuusa ku ngombo ya Baraka Obama eya "Yes We Can" eyamuyamba okutuuka mu woofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, omukugu w'akabondo yagamba nti okukola kuno kijja kuleetera abantu okukola emirimu era kino kijja kuleetera okukola ebintu ebyetaago.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekijulira ekyo kijja kuleeta mu bitundu 20 e Gulu kyaliwo nga Jjulaayi 25 ne kijja kutandika nga Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu abo mu kitundu e Gulu abo abali mu kiseera kino kye kikola ekyo kye kisobozesa.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti abamu ku bamemba ba UPDF baali bamu ku mukago gwa UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Abalala baali baagala ku bitongole by'okwerinda eby'okwerinda ng'abagamba nti baali batandika okukola engeri y'abantu abalwanyisa abalwanyisa abalwana.
items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Aba ADF bameka baali beegatta ku kusasula kwabwe.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Ofiisi ya ADF eyafulumya ekitongole kya bannamateeka ne kikakasa e Kitante eky'okukola eky'okukola abantu ab'ekyokulabirako ekitongole kya ADF.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kugezesa gavumenti, ebifo by'ab'omu kibiina ab'enguzi ba ADF abali mu nnyanja zaabwe bali bibeetaaga.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baali bamu ku mulamwa gwa bannange nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagumu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku bawagizi baabwe baali bakyamutuusa era abo abali ku mutindo gwa gavumenti baali bagamba nti baali basobola okukola obulumbaganyi obw'obutujju.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abaali mu kibiina ky'ab'eby'okwerinda baakola enkola ey'okugulana abo ababakwatiddwa ADF abalwanyisa gavumenti okugamba nti baagala okukola.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Aba ADF baali bavumirira gavumenti nti baagala okukola era n'okukola nga tebawulira ssente.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Abatujju b'obutujju ebyaliwo mu Kampala nga Jjulaayi 11 byatulugunyizibwa nti baali bakolwanga n'ab'ekibiina kya ADF ne Basmalaali basiraamu.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abantu abasinga obungi abo abali mu ADF beeyongedde okwewala mu kifo ky'okukola emirimu.

items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Olupapula lwa Independent olwa Jjulaayi 2010 lwafulumira nti abo abalina obuyinza b'ekibiina kya ADF tebaagala kufuna ssente naye abawandiisi be baafuna mu kifo ky'obuyinza.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.
